---
title: "Annotation-informed models"
format: html
---

Annotations must have explicit marker alignment, finite values, unique names,
and deterministic column order. Preprocessing occurs once per fit.

ST summary models provide fixed marker probabilities/scales, group parameters,
learned logistic effects, and probit-stick component probabilities. MT
BayesRC/SBayesRC uses annotation-dependent component probabilities with global
trait-pattern probabilities conditional on being non-null.

Prior component probabilities and posterior component-state probabilities are
separate outputs. Annotations do not create annotation-specific covariance
matrices or component multipliers.
